threads.body:
[Simplification] Use type-inferred `mock()` here, as the nearby `Cluster`, `Registry` and directory mocks already do. That removes the raw `Invoker.class` mock and the `@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")` it needs.

```suggestion
    Invoker<Object> provider = mock();
```

replies.body: Changed in 70fe368a79. I tried `Invoker<Object> provider = mock()` first. With Mockito 4.11, javac reports unchecked generic array creation for `Invoker<Object>[]`, which fails the build under `-Werror`. A test-local `ProviderInvoker extends Invoker<Object>` lets Mockito infer the type without a warning suppression.
